controls.label: Shape model
controls.notes: Published Jacobi-ellipsoid interpretation, with semiaxes 470 ±20, 383 ±10 and 245 ±8 km. It assumes hydrostatic equilibrium and a 6.75-hour rotation; the smooth shape is inferred from occultations, not imaged terrain. Illustrative pole RA 0°, declination 90° and arbitrary meridian. The paper’s local projected-limb and opening angles do not provide a unique absolute surface attitude for this display. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
